instructions: Remote GitHub data through the gh CLI. Needs network access; local work shows up only after it is pushed. Not a replacement for local git: use Bash for local history and uncommitted changes. Prefer these tools over WebFetch for GitHub URLs, which return about 200 KB of HTML. Needs the gh CLI installed and authenticated (gh auth login). A default repository in .mcp-gh-tooling.json saves passing a repository on every call.
